briefings.headline: Bears heading to UK for 5-city tour in October
briefings.summary: The Bears are preparing to do what no other NFL team has done — visit every nation in the United Kingdom during a three-week trip this October. Da Chicago Bears UK Grand Tour will feature stops in Bournemouth, Cardiff, Leeds, Glasgow and Belfast. This tour will mark the first time the Bears have traveled to all five cities, showcasing the organization’s commitment to connecting with the team’s growing international fanbase and making American football and the Bears brand more accessible, inclusive and engaging for young people.
